title: Mods
summary: Mods are packages that add to the app: agents, model providers, optional features and skills. Each has a version, an author and its own page on the site. When you sign in, only the essential mods are installed; install the others from the site.
usage: Open Settings › Mods. Installed has the mods you chose: turn each one on or off, open its settings or uninstall it. Essentials has the mods the app always keeps on. To install a mod, open its page on the site while signed in, choose the environment and click Install in JayV; the app syncs right away and the mod shows up in Installed, turned on, along with the mods it needs. Search filters by name, description or author. Changes apply when you save, in this environment and on your other computers; the site (Dashboard › Mods) shows the same mods. An uninstalled mod doesn't come back on its own, and one that needs a newer version waits for the update. Your plan still decides what stays off or on. The book button opens the mod's page on the site. All of this is also in Ctrl+K.
